mappings.name: Tiktok PDP (Product Detail Page) v3
mappings.description: product-skus PDP mapping for the flatter export shape (no {XX}_shops wrapper; bare country-code folders, now including GB/US) whose page payload is a Remix/Next.js-style route loader structure: loaderData['(product_name_slug$)/(product_id)/page'].page_config.components_map[N].component_data.product_info (N varies per file, located via filter:component_type==product_info) instead of Tiktok-PDP-1's data.product_details[0] or Tiktok-PDP-2's product_details.goda_protocol.global.product_info_resp.products[0]. Column sources are otherwise copied from Tiktok-PDP-1, which already carried product_model/seller_model/promotion_model/review_model fallback paths matching this shape almost exactly. From 2026-09-24 the payload is flattened onto component_data.product_info (empty product_model; skus/title/images/desc_blocks/price directly on product_info) — handled by trailing || fallbacks, so both shapes resolve per entry.
